title: One Piece, Vol. 1: Romance Dawn
description: Monkey D. Luffy embarks on his quest to find the legendary One Piece treasure and become King of the Pirates after gaining rubber powers from eating a Devil Fruit.

title: One Piece, Vol. 2: Buggy the Clown
description: Luffy and swordsman Roronoa Zoro confront the treacherous pirate captain Buggy the Clown and meet skilled thief Nami.

title: Naruto, Vol. 1: Uzumaki Naruto
description: Twelve-year-old ninja outcast Naruto Uzumaki dreams of becoming the village Hokage while harboring the sealed Nine-Tailed Fox spirit.

title: Dragon Ball, Vol. 1: The Monkey King
description: Young martial artist Son Goku and teen genius Bulma journey across mystical lands in search of the seven wish-granting Dragon Balls.

title: Attack on Titan, Vol. 1
description: Humanity lives behind three massive concentric walls to survive flesh-eating giants. When a Colossal Titan breaches Wall Maria, Eren Yeager vows to eliminate every Titan.

title: Death Note, Vol. 1: Boredom
description: Genius student Light Yagami discovers a supernatural notebook that kills anyone whose name is written in it, launching a cat-and-mouse duel with enigmatic detective L.

title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba, Vol. 1: Cruelty
description: Kindhearted Tanjiro Kamado becomes a Demon Slayer to avenge his slaughtered family and find a cure to turn his demonized sister Nezuko back into a human.

title: Jujutsu Kaisen, Vol. 1: Ryomen Sukuna
description: High schooler Yuji Itadori swallows the cursed rotting finger of the King of Curses Ryomen Sukuna to save classmates, entering the deadly world of Jujutsu sorcerers.

title: Chainsaw Man, Vol. 1: Dog & Chainsaw
description: Impoverished devil hunter Denji fuses with his pet chainsaw devil Pochita, reviving as a devil-human hybrid recruited by Public Safety agent Makima.

title: Spy x Family, Vol. 1
description: Master spy Twilight adopts a mind-reading telepath daughter and marries an undercover assassin wife, creating an eccentric fake family with conflicting secret identities.

title: Tokyo Ghoul, Vol. 1
description: College student Ken Kaneki survives a deadly date with a flesh-eating ghoul only to wake up as Tokyo's first human-ghoul hybrid struggling for survival in the urban shadows.

title: Fullmetal Alchemist, Vol. 1
description: Alchemist brothers Edward and Alphonse Elric search for the legendary Philosopher's Stone to restore their bodies after a tragic human transmutation attempt.

title: Berserk, Vol. 1
description: The Black Swordsman Guts brandishes a massive dragonslayer blade and prosthetic cannon arm across a dark fantasy realm, seeking vengeance against former comrades.

title: Watchmen
description: A seminal Hugo Award-winning deconstruction of superhero mythology set in an alternate Cold War 1985 as masked vigilantes investigate the murder of the Comedian.

title: Batman: Year One
description: Billionaire Bruce Wayne returns to Gotham City to wage a one-man war on crime while rookie lieutenant James Gordon navigates police corruption.

title: Batman: The Dark Knight Returns
description: An aging, fifty-five-year-old Bruce Wayne comes out of retirement in a dystopian future Gotham overrun by mutant gangs, facing a fateful showdown with Superman.

title: Batman: The Killing Joke
description: The definitive psychological origin story of the Joker and his sadistic attempt to drive Commissioner Gordon to madness to prove one bad day can shatter anyone.

title: V for Vendetta
description: In a post-apocalyptic fascist Great Britain, an enigmatic Guy Fawkes-masked anarchist named V orchestrates an elaborate revolutionary campaign of resistance.

title: The Sandman, Vol. 1: Preludes & Nocturnes
description: Morpheus, Lord of the Dreaming, escapes decades of occult imprisonment and journeys across worlds to reclaim his stolen sand, ruby, and helm of power.

title: The Sandman, Vol. 2: The Doll's House
description: While Dream continues rebuilding his realm, a rare dream vortex manifests in young Rose Walker, drawing him to an unsettling serial killer convention.

title: Maus I: A Survivor's Tale: My Father Bleeds History
description: The Pulitzer Prize-winning graphic novel depicting Art Spiegelman interviewing his Polish Jewish father Vladek about surviving the Holocaust.

title: Maus II: A Survivor's Tale: And Here My Troubles Began
description: The concluding installment of Spiegelman's Holocaust testimony following Vladek and Anja inside Auschwitz and Dachau death camps.

title: Persepolis: The Story of a Childhood
description: An insightful graphic memoir recounting Marjane Satrapi's childhood in Tehran during the Islamic Revolution and Iran-Iraq War in stark black-and-white art.

title: Heartstopper: Volume 1
description: A sweet British LGBTQ+ coming-of-age graphic novel following openly gay overthinker Charlie Spring and softhearted rugby player Nick Nelson as they become friends and fall in love.

title: Heartstopper: Volume 2
description: Nick comes to terms with his feelings for Charlie and begins navigating coming out to his mother and friends while their romantic bond deepens.
